verdict.rationale: Mercury documents AI that reads vendor bills, fills in their details automatically, and moves them to approval and payment. Approval controls can gate outgoing payments according to organization policies, which covers the routing part of the story. However, nothing in the evidence shows purchase-order matching, and GL coding of bills is not shown beyond general AI-powered accounting-sync automations. Missing for 10: invoice-to-PO matching, explicit automatic GL coding of bills, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI bill-pay flow.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have vendor invoices automatically matched to purchase orders, coded, and routed for payment

citations.quote: AI reads bills, populates details automatically, and remembers past recipients — so you can approve and pay in seconds.
Pay recipients from your Mercury accounts over ACH, check, domestic wire, and international wire, with optional approval controls.
Create a "request to send money" that will require approval based on your organization's approval policies.
